# core_module_not_shipped.txt lists a top-50 core module that ships no
# declarations/<Module/Path>.tpm, with the measurement that excluded it.
#
# Format: one entry per line, Module<TAB>full-uuid<TAB>reason. full-uuid is
# the full 36-character id of the issue or ruling that excluded the module,
# so the reason traces back to its source; a short prefix is rejected.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are comments, not entries.
#
# Ruling 4 (perigrin, 2026-10-16): not shipped is allowed only for
# Exporter, XSLoader and DynaLoader (RFC 0001's "may not ship"), and only
# after perigrin is asked, with the measurement, so the reason is his.
#
# Nothing has been cancelled: Exporter, XSLoader and DynaLoader each
# measured clean against the full corpus and shipped (see
# docs/contributing/core-module-declarations.md, "Modules other modules
# depend on"), so this file holds no entries.
